settings.title: What Is CBD?
settings.text: CBD (cannabidiol) is a naturally occurring compound found in hemp plants. Unlike THC, CBD is non-psychoactive — it won't get you high. It interacts with the body's endocannabinoid system and is associated with benefits for sleep, mood, inflammation, and overall wellness. Hemp-derived CBD products contain no more than 0.3% THC and are federally legal in all 50 states.

settings.title: What Is Hemp?
settings.text: Hemp (Cannabis sativa) is the same species as the marijuana plant but is bred to contain no more than 0.3% THC. It's a fast-growing plant with a long history of use across textiles, food, and wellness. All NextEvo products are made from 100% U.S.-grown hemp.

settings.title: What Are The Effects Of CBD?
settings.text: CBD is associated with positive effects on mood, anxiety, inflammation, and sleep quality. NextEvo's SmartSorb™ formulas are clinically designed to deliver those benefits faster and more completely than standard oil-based products.

settings.title: Will CBD Get Me High?
settings.text: No. All NextEvo products are 100% THC-free and non-psychoactive. CBD works by supporting your body's endocannabinoid system — it promotes balance and wellbeing without any intoxicating effects.

settings.title: Is CBD Regulated By The FDA?
settings.text: CBD is classified as a dietary supplement and is not regulated by the FDA. As such, CBD products are not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease. NextEvo products are manufactured in an FDA-inspected, GMP-certified facility and independently third-party tested for quality and purity.

settings.title: How Much CBD Should I Take?
settings.text: All NextEvo products include dosage guidance on the label. If you're new to CBD, start with 10–20mg per day for the first week, then increase by 5mg weekly until you find your optimal dose. Maximum recommended daily dose is 80–120mg. As with any supplement, consult your healthcare provider if you have questions specific to your situation.

settings.title: Can I Take CBD With Other Medications?
settings.text: As with any supplement, consult your doctor or healthcare provider before taking CBD if you are on medication. Our clinical team has reviewed the safety profile of our formulations extensively, but individual health circumstances vary.

settings.title: About CBD
How is NextEvo CBD Different?
settings.text: NextEvo is the only CBD brand founded by former Johnson & Johnson pharmaceutical executives, with 30+ patents in drug delivery behind our formulas. Our proprietary SmartSorb™ technology converts CBD into a water-soluble form that absorbs 6x better and acts 40x faster than standard oil-based CBD — validated in peer-reviewed clinical trials, not just internal testing. Every product is THC-free, vegan, non-GMO, gluten-free, and manufactured in an FDA-inspected, GMP-certified U.S. facility.

settings.title: What is Smartsorb™ Technology?
settings.text: SmartSorb™ is NextEvo's patented water-soluble CBD delivery system. Most CBD products are oil-based — and since your body is roughly 60% water, oil-based CBD is poorly absorbed, with as little as 10% reaching your bloodstream. SmartSorb™ converts CBD into microscopic water-soluble particles that absorb directly through the intestinal wall, delivering 6x more CBD into your system in the first 30 minutes compared to oil-based products.

settings.title: How Quickly Do NextEvo Naturals Take Effect?
settings.text: Thanks to SmartSorb™ technology, NextEvo products can be felt in as little as 10 minutes — 40x faster than traditional oil-based CBD formulas. Most users report noticeable effects within the first 30 minutes of taking our capsules, gummies, or dissolvable powder.

settings.title: Why Doesn’t NextEvo Make CBD Oil?
settings.text: Because oil-based CBD is an inferior delivery format. Our pharmaceutical background taught us that bioavailability — how much of a compound actually reaches your bloodstream — is everything. SmartSorb™ technology delivers 6x better absorption than oil. Making an oil would mean deliberately building a less effective product. We're not willing to do that.

settings.title: Where Are NextEvo Naturals Made?
settings.text: All NextEvo products are grown and manufactured in the USA in an FDA-inspected, GMP-certified facility.

settings.title: Are NextEvo Naturals 3rd-Party Tested?
settings.text: Yes. Every batch is independently tested by a third-party laboratory for potency, purity, and the absence of pesticides, heavy metals, and contaminants. Certificates of Analysis (COAs) are publicly available for every product on our lab results page.

settings.title: Will CBD Make Me Fail a Drug Test?
settings.text: All NextEvo products are 100% THC-free. Standard drug tests screen for THC, not CBD. However, if you are subject to workplace drug testing, we recommend consulting with your employer or a healthcare provider before use, as individual sensitivities can vary.

settings.title: Are NextEvo Naturals Vegan and Gluten Free?
settings.text: Yes. All NextEvo products are vegan, gluten-free, non-GMO, and free from artificial colors and preservatives.
